method: public Result hardwoodRowStrings() throws IOException { long values = 0; long length = 0; long firstChars = 0; try (HardwoodContext context = BenchContext.create(); ParquetFileReader reader = ParquetFileReader.open(InputFile.of(FILE), context); RowReader rows = reader.buildRowReader().projection(ColumnProjection.columns(COLUMNS)).build()) { while (rows.hasNext()) { rows.next(); for (int c = 0; c < COLUMNS.length; c++) { if (rows.isNull(c)) { continue; } String value = rows.getString(c); values++; length += value.length(); firstChars += value.charAt(0); } } } return new Result(values, length, firstChars); }
